relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: StandardAero stock hits 52-week low at 23.81 USD By Investing.com

Despite this downturn, InvestingPro data suggests the stock may be undervalued with a PEG ratio of 0.18, and analysts have revised earnings upwards. The company also reported strong Q2 revenue and adjusted earnings, maintaining an Outperform rating from Bernstein SocGen Group.

feed.title: Capital City Bank Group declares $0.27 quarterly dividend By Investing.com
feed.summary: Capital City Bank Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:CCBG) has announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.27 per share on its common stock. The dividend is scheduled for payment on September 22, 2026, to shareholders recorded as of September 8, 2026, representing an annualized yield of 2.11% based on a recent closing stock price. The company, a financial holding entity based in Florida, manages approximately $4.5 billion in assets through its subsidiary Capital City Bank.

feed.title: These are Minnesota's largest private companies ranked by revenue
feed.summary: This article lists Minnesota's largest private companies based on their 2025 revenue, totaling $334 billion across the state. Cargill Inc. alone accounts for nearly half of this total, with other significant companies including CHS Inc., Land O'Lakes Inc., and M.A. Mortenson Co. The article provides key financial data, addresses, and brief business descriptions for these top firms.

feed.title: Chime Financial Co-Founder Ryan King Sells 42,421 Shares Under 10b5-1 Trading Plan
feed.summary: Ryan A. King, Co-Founder of Chime Financial, sold 42,421 shares of Class A Common Stock at a weighted average price of $35.1476 per share on September 9, 2026. The sale was executed under a pre-established Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted on August 28, 2025. Following the transaction, King retains significant indirect holdings of Class B Common Stock through various trusts and 116,667 Class A shares directly.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Celsius Holdings, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against Celsius Holdings, Inc. (CELH) and certain officers, alleging violations of federal securities laws. The lawsuit claims that Celsius made false and misleading statements and/or failed to disclose cardiac risks associated with their "Alani Nu" products and targeted underage consumers. Investors who purchased Celsius securities between February 21, 2023, and June 3, 2024, are encouraged to join the case by November 3, 2026.

feed.title: Moderna Rallies 8% on 2026 Melt-Up Momentum Even While BioNTech and Merck Stay Flat
feed.summary: Moderna (NASDAQ: MRNA) stock surged 8% despite no specific news, trial readouts, or analyst calls, while its peers BioNTech and Merck remained flat or slightly down. This unexpected rally follows a 143% gain over the past month due to a successful late-stage melanoma trial in August. The current surge is likely driven by momentum buying or a short squeeze, as broader market and sector movements do not account for Moderna's stock-specific event.

feed.title: Moderna Rallies 8% on 2026 Melt-Up Momentum Even While BioNTech and Merck Stay Flat
feed.summary: Moderna (MRNA) stock surged 8% despite its biotech peers BioNTech and Merck remaining largely flat, suggesting a stock-specific event rather than a sector-wide trend. The rally comes after Moderna had already seen a 143% increase in the past month due to a successful late-stage melanoma trial in August, with no new clinical or regulatory triggers for Friday's jump. Analysts suggest the movement is likely due to momentum buying or a short squeeze, given the absence of new fundamental news.

feed.title: Franklin Templeton Announces Distributions for Certain Closed-End Funds Pursuant to their Managed Distribution Policy for the Month of September 2026
feed.summary: Franklin Templeton has announced distributions for several of its closed-end funds for September 2026, in line with their managed distribution policy. Funds like Templeton Dragon Fund Inc. (TDF) and Templeton Emerging Markets Fund (EMF) will pay out specified amounts to shareholders on September 30, 2026. The policy aims to maintain consistent distribution levels using income, capital gains, or return of capital, with the understanding that these distributions do not necessarily reflect investment performance and can be modified by the Board of Directors.

feed.title: Q&A: ‘Opine with the spine’: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder on leading through the AI shift
feed.summary: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder discusses how she is leading the software giant through the AI shift with a new brand campaign, "The World is Yours for the Making," which emphasizes human creativity. She explains her approach to marketing, highlighting the emotional aspect of B2B purchases and the importance of supporting her global marketing team through technological advancements. Treseder also shares insights from her diverse CMO experience at Peloton, GE, and Carbon, emphasizing curiosity, conviction, and courage.

feed.title: Cruising gluten-free: Inside Royal Caribbean’s Celiac Cruise experience
feed.summary: This article details Julia's positive experience on a Royal Caribbean Celiac Cruise after her celiac disease diagnosis made travel challenging. The cruise, partnered with Celiac Cruise, offers dedicated gluten-free dining spaces, trained staff, and special wristbands to ensure a worry-free vacation for guests with celiac disease. The program has been very successful, leading to expansion and even inspiring Oceania Cruises to offer a similar entirely gluten-free voyage.

feed.title: Why This Apple Supplier Is on Pace for Its Best 5-Day Stretch in 17 Years
feed.summary: Skyworks Solutions, an Apple supplier, is experiencing its best five-day stock performance in 17 years. This surge occurred after CEO Philip Brace provided an update to investors regarding a crucial merger. The stock closed higher for the fifth consecutive trading session on Friday.

feed.title: Cheetah Mobile Releases Q2 2026 Financial Results
feed.summary: Cheetah Mobile Inc. (CMCM) reported its Q2 2026 financial results, with adjusted earnings of -¥0.06 per share and revenue of ¥266.1M, which was in line with estimates but down 9.9% year-over-year. The company posted a net loss of ¥86.9M, while its cloud and AI infrastructure revenue showed significant growth of 83.1%. Wall Street consensus includes 0 buy, 2 hold, and 1 sell ratings for CMCM.

feed.title: FutureMain Co., ltd. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger and Business Combination Agreement to acquire ChampionsGate Acquisition Corporation in a reverse merger transaction for an enterprise value of $80 million.
feed.summary: FutureMain Co., ltd. has entered into a reverse merger agreement to acquire ChampionsGate Acquisition Corporation for an enterprise value of $80 million. The transaction involves shareholders of Holdco receiving shares of Pubco, valued at $10.00 per share, and is expected to close in 2027, pending regulatory and shareholder approvals. FocalPoint Asia served as the financial advisor for FutureMain.

feed.title: Canadian Natural Resources (TSX:CNQ) Climbs To Fresh Yearly High
feed.summary: Canadian Natural Resources (TSX:CNQ) reached a new yearly high before a slight pullback, indicating sustained momentum. Analysts hold mixed sentiments, with a lean towards favorable outlooks but a cautious collective target price. The company's recent quarterly results show strong profitability and efficient operations, driven by its diversified asset base and significant scale in the energy sector.

feed.title: SMCI or NTAP: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
feed.summary: This article compares Super Micro Computer (SMCI) and NetApp (NTAP) as potential value stock investments, both currently holding a Zacks Rank of #1 (Strong Buy). Analyzing valuation metrics like P/E, PEG, and P/B ratios, the article concludes that SMCI appears to be the superior value option with stronger metrics compared to NTAP.

feed.title: Arcturus Therapeutics at cantoral global healthcare conference: data catalysts ahead
feed.summary: Arcturus Therapeutics presented at the 12th Annual Cantor Fitzgerald Global Healthcare Conference, highlighting its pipeline with three key programs: an OTC deficiency therapy, an inhaled cystic fibrosis treatment, and a self-amplifying mRNA platform. The company anticipates several critical data readouts and decisions, including Phase II data for its OTC deficiency program and a Q4 decision on its cystic fibrosis treatment, which could unlock significant funding. Arcturus emphasized its differentiated technology, strong safety profiles, and strategic partnerships as it aims to address unmet medical needs and generate non-dilutive funding.

feed.title: Megan Terrell Puts People at the Center of Analytics
feed.summary: Megan Terrell, People Analytics Manager at Howmet Aerospace Inc., focuses on integrating technology with a people-centric approach to HR metrics and predictive modeling. Terrell, who moved to Pittsburgh in 2021, emphasizes community building, mentorship, and empowering individuals alongside technological advancements like AI. Her work extends to significant community involvement, including co-founding Howmet’s Outdoor Club, leading the Howmet Women’s Network, and fundraising for local charities, reflecting her belief that surrounding oneself with positive inputs dictates positive outputs.

feed.title: Bank7 Corp. Boosts Century Financial Acquisition Offer to $88.96 Million After Court Auction
feed.summary: Bank7 Corp. has increased its acquisition offer for Century Financial Services Corporation to $88.96 million after winning a court-supervised auction with a $91 million bid. The revised price reflects a $2.04 million break-up fee credit. The deal, which covers approximately 71% of Century's common stock, is contingent on court and regulatory approvals.

feed.title: AI Data Centers Need Enormous Amounts of Power: These 5 Dividend Stocks Provide It
feed.summary: The article highlights five dividend utility stocks poised to benefit from the massive power demands of AI data centers. Companies like Southern Company, Duke Energy, WEC Energy Group, Xcel Energy, and Consolidated Edison are expanding their infrastructure to meet this growing demand, turning capital expenditures into predictable earnings and steady dividends. Each company offers unique advantages and risks, catering to different investment strategies focused on income durability or growth potential.

feed.title: General Mills saw base pricing reduction as ‘biggest issue’
feed.summary: General Mills executives discussed their decision to lower base prices as a pivotal move at the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference. This strategy, aimed at addressing pricing gaps and improving value, led to improved results, including stabilized base volume and growth in household penetration for most categories. Despite a slower-than-expected volume recovery and the need to fix underperforming brands, the company is confident in its position for future growth as it shifts focus to innovation.

feed.title: Cathay General Bancorp CFO Albert Jen-Wen Wang Vests 4,012 Restricted Stock Units and Sells Shares for Tax Withholding
feed.summary: Cathay General Bancorp CFO Albert Jen-Wen Wang vested 4,012 restricted stock units on September 8, 2026. Simultaneously, 1,294 shares were sold at $61.86 each to cover tax withholding obligations. Following these transactions, Wang directly holds 2,718 shares of the company's common stock.

feed.title: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce : Publication of Second Amended Final Terms (XS3435397115, SPUK 126)
feed.summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce has published its Second Amended Final Terms for Index Linked Interest and Redemption Notes due September 2033 (XS3435397115, SPUK 126). These terms detail the contractual conditions, interest payment structure linked to the S&P 500® and EURO STOXX 50® indices, and redemption provisions for the GBP 250,000 issue. The document also outlines regulatory compliance, target market information, and disclaimers regarding the underlying indices.

feed.title: Accountability, oversight and AI: Inside Microsoft’s security transformation
feed.summary: After enduring several high-profile cyberattacks, Microsoft launched its Secure Future Initiative (SFI) in November 2023 to transform its cybersecurity approach. The initiative emphasizes cultural change, accountability, and the integration of AI scanning tools like MDASH to identify vulnerabilities early in the development process. Microsoft is also implementing secure-by-default policies and requiring multifactor authentication for Azure, indicating a significant shift towards prioritizing security across its products and operations.

feed.title: Cisco (CSCO) Down 5.3% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
feed.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) shares have dropped 5.3% since its last earnings report, underperforming the S&P 500, but the company's Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings beat estimates with strong networking revenue growth. The company reported non-GAAP earnings of $1.22 per share and revenues of $17.252 billion, driven by broad networking demand and significant growth in AI infrastructure orders. Despite a decline in gross margin, operating margin expanded, and Cisco provided a strong outlook for fiscal 2027, projecting revenues of $72.2-$73.4 billion and non-GAAP earnings of $5.05-$5.11 per share.

feed.title: [U.S. Equities] Dow Inc surges, up $604; Nasdaq also higher (morning of the 11th)
feed.summary: Dow Inc. (DOW) experienced a significant surge, increasing by $604, contributing to an overall positive trend in the U.S. equities market. The Nasdaq also saw gains during the morning trading session on the 11th. This indicates a strong start for the market, particularly for industrial stocks.

feed.title: Attack damages Bunge oilseeds plant in Ukraine
feed.summary: A Bunge Global SA oilseeds processing plant in Dnipro, Ukraine, was damaged on September 10 by a Russian attack. No employees were injured in the incident. This attack is part of an intensifying trend where both Russia and Ukraine target each other's agricultural infrastructure, severely impacting agricultural exports and global vegetable oil supplies.

feed.title: Intel Climbs 3% on Chip Price Hike Report a Day After Piper Sandler Went Neutral; AMD Rises 2%, Taiwan Semiconductor Drifts
feed.summary: Intel's stock surged 3% following reports of a potential 10% price hike on its PC processors, extending its significant year-to-date gains. This rise occurred despite Piper Sandler initiating coverage with a "Neutral" rating and a $110 price target due to execution risks and data center competition. While Intel led the semiconductor sector, AMD saw a 2% increase and Taiwan Semiconductor a marginal 0.36% gain, indicating a company-specific catalyst rather than a broad market surge.

feed.title: Form 8K BioRestorative Therapies Inc For: 11 September By Investing.com
feed.summary: This article reports on BioRestorative Therapies Inc.'s Form 8K filing on September 11, 2026. Form 8K is a crucial document that public companies must file with the SEC to announce significant events that shareholders should know about. The brief piece indicates that Investing.com provided this information to its readers.

feed.title: REGN SHAREHOLDER NOTICE: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Regeneron Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on September 14, 2026
feed.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is reminding Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: REGN) investors of the September 14, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff status in a federal securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Regeneron made misleading statements regarding its Phase III Fianlimab-Libtayo Study, which ultimately failed to meet its primary endpoint, causing significant stock price drops in April and May 2026. Investors who purchased Regeneron securities between August 1, 2025, and May 15, 2026, and suffered losses are encouraged to contact the firm to discuss their legal options.

feed.title: Quince Keeps Win as Court Says No New Trial in UGG Patent Case
feed.summary: A U.S. District Court has denied Deckers Outdoor Corporation's request for a new trial in its patent infringement case against Quince, thereby preserving Quince's victory. The court upheld the jury's finding that although Quince infringed Deckers' UGG design patent, the patent itself was invalid. This ruling confirms that establishing infringement is only one step, as the patent's validity must also withstand legal challenge.

feed.title: Chubb Voluntarily Drops Coverage Suit Over Chips Used by Russia
feed.summary: Chubb Ltd. has voluntarily dismissed its lawsuit against Mouser Electronics Inc., a Berkshire Hathaway company, regarding insurance coverage for litigation involving chips allegedly used by Russia in missile and drone strikes against Ukrainian civilians. Chubb had argued that policy exclusions related to aircraft products and war-related damages barred coverage, but Mouser did not respond to the complaint. The dismissal was filed in the US District Court for the Northern District of Texas.

feed.title: Verizon vs. SpaceX: Which Stock Has Better Growth Prospects?
feed.summary: This article compares the growth prospects of Verizon (VZ) and SpaceX (SPCX), two major players in the connectivity market. Verizon benefits from its 5G network expansion and customer additions, while SpaceX dominates the launch industry and is rapidly expanding its Starlink satellite internet service, with ambitions to become an AI infrastructure company. While SpaceX shows higher projected sales growth, Verizon appears more attractive from a valuation standpoint and offers more immediate upside potential due to its aggressive growth strategy.

feed.title: Colgate-Palmolive exploring $1B divestment of select brands, Reuters reports
feed.summary: Colgate-Palmolive is reportedly exploring the sale of several mass-market personal care brands, including Softsoap, Irish Spring, and Speed Stick, in a deal that could exceed $1 billion. This strategic move, aided by Goldman Sachs, aims to streamline its portfolio and allow the consumer products giant to focus on higher-margin categories like oral care and pet nutrition. The divestment reflects a broader trend among consumer packaged goods companies to optimize operations amid economic pressures and rising costs.

feed.title: Volunteers remove buckthorn as part of Xcel Energy's Day of Service
feed.summary: Volunteers are participating in Xcel Energy's Day of Service by working to clear invasive buckthorn at the Wood Lake Nature Center. This initiative aims to improve the local environment through community effort.

feed.title: Kroger cuts forecast as inflation and grocery price war squeeze sales
feed.summary: Kroger has lowered its annual sales forecast due to persistent inflation and intense competition in the grocery sector, which are impacting consumer spending. The company expects comparable sales excluding fuel to grow by a maximum of 0.8%, down from a previous estimate of 2%. CEO Greg Foran is implementing strategies like price reductions and improved store services to gain market share amidst a challenging economic environment where consumers are tightening budgets.

feed.title: Insider Transaction: Laura Thompson Sells $153K Worth Of Parker Hannifin Shares
feed.summary: Laura Thompson, a Board Member at Parker Hannifin (NYSE: PH), sold 160 shares of the company for a total of $153,432 on September 10, according to an SEC filing. The article details Parker Hannifin's financial performance, including revenue growth, gross margin, EPS, debt management, and valuation metrics, and explains the significance of insider transactions for investors.

feed.title: Intuit CFO outlines bid to build an ‘end-to-end consumer platform’
feed.summary: Intuit CFO Sandeep Aujla announced plans to build a comprehensive "end-to-end consumer platform" aimed at regaining market share in consumer tax and attracting new business customers. This strategy involves leveraging Credit Karma for deeper engagement beyond tax season and expanding QuickBooks offerings to cross-sell services to small and midsize businesses. Intuit also aims to scale new-to-the-franchise customers through initiatives like free or lower-cost tax services.

feed.title: DuPont, Chemours, Corteva to pay $445M to settle ‘forever chemical’ suits
feed.summary: DuPont, Chemours, and Corteva have agreed to a $455 million settlement with the State of North Carolina and 11 local entities over PFAS "forever chemicals" contamination, largely from the Fayetteville Works facility. Chemours will be responsible for 50% of the payments, with DuPont and Corteva covering the other 50%. This settlement resolves existing litigation in North Carolina, although other lawsuits, including one in Delaware, are ongoing.

feed.title: Campbell’s heats up digital focus amid marketing reformulation
feed.summary: Campbell’s is overhauling its marketing strategy to adapt to changing consumer habits and address declining sales, particularly by increasing investments in digital channels like social media, influencers, e-commerce, and AI-powered platforms. Approximately 85% of its working media budget will be allocated to these digital efforts, with a focus on growth opportunities such as the Rao’s, Goldfish, and Pepperidge Farm brands. This shift aims to boost product trials and reinforce brand positioning, especially for Goldfish, which is getting an omnichannel push and new product variations.

feed.title: L3harris Technologies stock hits 52-week low at 246.43 USD
feed.summary: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) stock has fallen to a 52-week low of $246.43, representing a 31% decline over the past six months and an 11.65% drop over the last year. Despite a recent beat on Q2 2026 earnings and revenue, the stock's performance has been impacted by broader market trends, company-specific challenges, and investor focus on future outlook and leadership changes. InvestingPro suggests the stock is oversold and potentially undervalued, indicating a buying opportunity.

feed.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Dell Surge 11% as Oracle's Capex Guidance Lifts AI Server Demand, Super Micro Climbs 7%
feed.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Dell stocks surged 11%, and Super Micro Computer climbed 7% following Oracle's announcement of a significant capital spending plan for AI infrastructure. Oracle CFO Hilary Maxson confirmed $90-$95 billion in full-year CapEx, much of which is expected to flow to vendors providing AI rack, cooling, and networking solutions. This Oracle-driven demand is repricing the AI server sector, indicating a strong future for these suppliers.

feed.title: Wells Fargo & Company Has Lowered Expectations for Clorox (NYSE:CLX) Stock Price
feed.summary: Wells Fargo & Company has reduced its price target for Clorox (NYSE:CLX) from $102 to $90, while maintaining an "equal weight" rating, citing a potential upside of 4.22% from its current price. This follows a general cautious sentiment among analysts, with the stock currently holding an average "Reduce" rating and a consensus price target of $101.60. Clorox shares traded near their 52-week low after the company reported a 2% decline in sales year-over-year and a significant drop in EPS, despite slightly exceeding quarterly earnings and revenue expectations.

feed.title: Arista Networks Jumps 5.4% Amid Sector-Wide Rally
feed.summary: Arista Networks (ANET) surged 5.4% to $199.26 on Friday, driven by a broad rally across the networking equipment sector and significant trading volume. This sector-wide momentum also saw other key players like Cisco Systems, Ciena, F5 Networks, and Viavi Solutions post notable gains. The synchronized uplift suggests investor enthusiasm for networking infrastructure, pushing Arista's market capitalization to $251.3 billion.

feed.title: Boyd Group Stock Outlook: TSX:BYD Rallies 6.22% as Management Signals Shares Are Undervalued
feed.summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. (TSX:BYD) saw its stock rally 6.22% after announcing a Normal Course Issuer Bid to repurchase up to 2.779 million shares, representing approximately 10% of its public float. Management believes the shares are undervalued, particularly following a strong Q2 FY2026 where sales increased by 29.9% and adjusted EBITDA rose by 44.9%. The buyback, starting September 16, 2026, signals management's confidence in the company's growth profile, cash-generating capabilities, and operational improvements, including successful integration of Joe Hudson's Collision Centers and Project 360 cost savings.

feed.title: Brighthouse’s $4.1 Billion Takeover Drags as Regulators Dig In
feed.summary: Aquarian Holdings has missed its initial deadline to acquire Brighthouse Financial Inc. for $4.1 billion as regulators scrutinize the deal. The Delaware insurance regulator has questioned Aquarian's funding sources and management plans for Brighthouse's balance sheet, leading to investor doubt as Brighthouse shares trade well below the deal price. Aquarian is backed by Mubadala Capital, but is still seeking additional investors to complete the acquisition by the new December 6th deadline.

feed.title: Bitmine Surges 8% on Ethereum Strength After Cantor Fitzgerald Doubles Its Target, SharpLink Advances 9%, Strategy Gains 4%
feed.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) stock surged 8% after Cantor Fitzgerald doubled its price target to $63.60, driven by a 7% rally in Ethereum (ETH). Other crypto treasury stocks like SharpLink Gaming (SBET) and MicroStrategy (MSTR) also saw gains. The article highlights that these companies act as leveraged proxies for their underlying crypto holdings, magnifying both gains and potential drawdowns for investors.

feed.title: Earnings call transcript: Cheetah Mobile posts mixed Q2 2026 results as losses widen
feed.summary: Cheetah Mobile reported mixed Q2 2026 results with revenue up 9.9% year-over-year to RMB 266.1 million, but EPS losses widened to $0.062. The company is transitioning from legacy advertising to cloud, AI infrastructure, and robotics, which now account for 43% of total revenue. While these new growth areas are accelerating and internet services remain profitable, significant investments in them are increasing operating losses, causing the stock to fall.

feed.title: Bernstein SocGen cuts Linde stock price target on project analysis
feed.summary: Bernstein SocGen lowered its price target for Linde (NASDAQ:LIN) stock to $563 from $564, while maintaining an Outperform rating. The firm's analysis of Linde's announced projects suggests low-single-digit EPS growth annually through 2030, with 2030 EPS estimated to be 8% above consensus. Linde remains Bernstein SocGen's top pick in the sector, and an upcoming investor meeting in October is expected to provide further clarity on its growth pipeline.

feed.title: Expeditors International stock hits all-time high of 192.34 USD
feed.summary: Expeditors International of Washington Inc. (EXPD) stock has reached an all-time high of $192.34, marking a 55.11% increase over the past year. This surge reflects strong investor confidence and comes after the company reported robust revenue growth and raised its dividend for 29 consecutive years. Analysts have responded by raising price targets, despite some indicators suggesting the stock may be overvalued.

feed.title: Dow Jumps Over 1%; US Inflation Holds at 3.4% In August
feed.summary: US stocks traded higher, with the Dow Jones index gaining over 1%, the NASDAQ climbing 1.20%, and the S&P 500 rising 1.08%. This surge occurred as US annual inflation in August remained steady at 3.4%, matching market expectations and holding unchanged from July. Leading sectors included communication services, while commodities saw oil trading down and gold up.
